drills.name: QB throwing
drills.help: You are the QB. SPACE hikes. Then 1 to 4 throws to that receiver: tap for a bullet, hold CTRL for a lob. Nobody covers them.

drills.name: Throwing into coverage
drills.help: Same as QB throwing, but corners, safeties and a linebacker cover the receivers. Wait for one to get open. No pass rush.

drills.name: Catching
drills.help: You are a receiver. The QB throws to you after a moment, a bullet then a lob, over and over. Run under it (WASD) and watch the yellow catch circle.
drills.note: The offense 'calls' a run play so the bot QB never throws by himself; the lab throws for him at throwAtS.

drills.name: Tackling
drills.help: A runner comes at you with the ball. Get close (inside the red circle) and press F to tackle. Running hard and hitting him from behind both help.

drills.name: Running and juking
drills.help: You have the ball and three defenders chase you. Run for the end zone (SHIFT sprints). E jukes to the side you steer: tackles miss while it lasts.

drills.name: Cutting and reversing
drills.help: Just you on an empty field: run, cut back and forth, then turn right around. Watch the body: small cuts shift the stance a little, a full reverse plants a foot and leans hard the new way.
drills.note: The QB holds the ball (a run play with no back to hand it to), so the play never ends by itself. tools/motion.ps1 drives the runner here for the momentum reel.

drills.name: Cutting and reversing as a lineman
drills.help: The same as a big lineman (the linebacker's build, worn by the linemen too).

drills.name: Cutting and reversing with the ball
drills.help: The same with the ball in your arm.

drills.name: Full scrimmage
drills.help: All 22 players, Slants against Cover 3, you at QB. A normal play from the snap to the whistle, then it starts again.

drills.name: Watch the bots
drills.help: A full play with bots only. Turn on the hitboxes (V) and slow it down ([ and ]) to see who reaches whom.
